title: Billing & plan
subtitle: Your organization's subscription, monthly usage and invoices
mockBody: The billing provider is set to mock: plan changes apply instantly, no money is collected and the invoices shown are samples only.
checkoutSuccess: Payment received. Your subscription will update in a moment.
checkoutCanceled: Checkout canceled — you were not charged.
pastDueBody: Update your payment method within 14 days to keep paid features.
canceledBody: Paid features are disabled. Your data is kept — choose a plan to re-enable them.
endsOn: Subscription ends on {date}; the organization then moves to the Free plan
ownerOnly: Only organization owners can change the plan.
usageResets: Monthly quotas reset at the start of each month.
invoicesHelp: Subscription invoices from the billing provider
portalMockBody: This is a demo portal. In production you are sent to Stripe's secure portal to update payment methods and view invoices.
confirmChangeBody: The change takes effect immediately and billing is prorated.
confirmDowngradeBody: Paid features will be turned off. Your data is kept.
cancelBody: The subscription stays active until the end of the paid period, then the organization moves to the Free plan. Your data is kept.
cancelScheduled: Subscription will cancel at period end
noSubscription: No subscription found for this organization
tooManyMembers: This plan allows {limit} users and your organization has {current} active users. Disable users before switching.
tooManyContacts: This plan allows {limit} contacts and your organization has {current}. Delete or merge contacts before switching.
tooManyWorkflows: This plan allows {limit} automations and your organization has {current}. Archive some before switching.
priceNotConfigured: This plan has no price configured at the billing provider
liveDisabled: Live billing is disabled in this environment
providerError: The billing provider returned an error. Try again in a few minutes.
nothingToCancel: There is no paid subscription to cancel
notCanceling: The subscription is not scheduled to cancel
